DT_BuildObjectDescText.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_Palvolve_ElementExtract: Breaks skill fruits and elemental materials down into pure essences and forges Evolution and Adaptation Stones.
DT_BuildObjectDescText.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_Palvolve_FusionAltar: Place two Pals here and they fuse into one for good. Costs a Fusion Core.

DT_TechnologyDescText.DESC_RECIPE_Palvolve_ElementExtractor: Unlocks the Pal Alchemy Workbench - the home of essence extraction, Evolution Stones and Adaptation Stones.
DT_TechnologyDescText.DESC_RECIPE_Palvolve_FusionAltar: Unlocks the Fusion Altar, where two Pals become one for good.
